video.q: Does Pipeline AI make the video itself?
video.a: Yes, as an option on paid plans: a 1080p MP4 video with the generated images, an ElevenLabs voice-over, synced captions and simple transitions, ready to publish. The script comes first: you review and adjust it your way, then the video follows it as written. Without the option, it delivers the script, titles, SEO, voice-over text and thumbnails.

object.title: Purpose
object.body:
Pipeline AI is a service published by {publisher}. From a brief, it uses artificial intelligence models to generate the script, titles, SEO elements, voiceover text and thumbnail concepts of a YouTube video.

These terms apply to any use of the service. By creating an account, you accept them, along with the usage policy and the privacy policy.

account.title: Account
account.body:
You sign in with a link sent to your email address, or with Google. You are responsible for access to your mailbox and for what is done from your account.

A workspace can have several members. Its administrators choose the roles and are responsible for how their members use it.

credits.title: Credits, plans and payment
credits.body:
Each deliverable costs a number of credits that depends on the video's length and tier, shown before every run. Credits are reserved at launch; only successfully generated deliverables are charged, the others are released automatically.

- The Free plan grants credits once, at sign-up.
- Paid plans are monthly subscriptions, renewed automatically until cancelled, which you can do at any time from the Billing page. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period.
- Credit packs are one-off purchases.
- Prices are shown in euros, taxes included: the sales taxes that apply where you live (GST and QST in Canada, VAT in the European Union) are included in the displayed price. Prices and plan contents: Pricing page. Payment is processed by Stripe.

Credits cannot be refunded in cash or transferred. Unused credits carry over to the next month, up to one monthly allocation; any excess expires at renewal.

withdrawal.title: Cancellation and withdrawal
withdrawal.body:
If you live in Québec, the Consumer Protection Act lets you cancel a distance contract in the cases and within the time limits it sets out, in particular if we did not send you the information or the contract it requires, or if the service is not supplied.

If you live in the European Union, you have 14 days to withdraw from a purchase. As the service is supplied immediately, starting a generation during this period counts as a request for immediate performance: you lose your right of withdrawal for the credits used.

content.title: Generated content
content.body:
Content is produced by AI models: it may contain errors, inaccuracies or wording close to existing content. You review it before publishing and remain responsible for what you publish, in particular under YouTube's rules and the law.

To the extent permitted by law, Pipeline AI claims no rights over the content generated for you. Similar content may be generated for other users.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.body: Use of the service is subject to the usage policy. A brief that falls in a refused category is rejected before any charge. Serious or repeated breaches may lead to suspension or closure of the account.

liability.title: Availability and liability
liability.body: The service is provided as is, on a best-efforts basis. It may be interrupted for maintenance or if a provider fails. Pipeline AI guarantees neither audience, monetization nor compliance of content with any platform rule.

termination.title: Closing your account
termination.body: You can delete your account at any time from the settings. Your subscriptions are then cancelled immediately, and your personal workspaces and their content are deleted.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: These terms may change. You are notified of any significant change before it takes effect; continuing to use the service counts as acceptance.

law.title: Governing law and disputes
law.body:
These terms are governed by the laws of Québec and the federal laws of Canada that apply there. The courts of the judicial district of Iberville have jurisdiction, subject to the rules that allow consumers to bring proceedings before the court where they live and to keep the mandatory protections of their place of residence.

In case of dispute, first write to {email}. If you live in Québec, you may also contact the Office de la protection du consommateur (opc.gouv.qc.ca).

controller.title: Who is responsible for your personal information
controller.body:
{publisher}, {address}, is responsible for the personal information collected by Pipeline AI.

The person in charge of the protection of personal information is {privacyOfficer}. For any question about your information or to exercise your rights: {email}.

data.title: Data we process
data.body:
- Account: email address, display name, interface language.
- Workspaces: name, members and roles, channel presets.
- Content: your briefs, regeneration instructions and the generated content, with its version history.
- Billing: Stripe customer ID and subscriptions, credit movements. Your card details are processed by Stripe and never reach us.
- Security: non-reversible fingerprints of your email address and IP address, used to limit the number of requests, erased after 24 hours at most.
- Closed beta: the email address of invited people, with an optional note, until the invitation is removed.
- Feedback: your 0-to-10 score and optional comment, if you answer the satisfaction question.
- Technical errors: error reports without IP address, cookies or request content.
- Usage analytics: three steps (sign-up, pipeline creation, payment), tied to a non-reversible pseudonymous identifier, with the video's tier and length or the offer purchased. No email, IP address, content or cookie.

purposes.title: Purposes, consent and legal bases
purposes.body:
- Providing the service and billing: performance of the contract.
- Keeping accounting records: legal obligation.
- Preventing abuse and securing the service (rate limits, brief moderation, spending alerts): legitimate interest.
- Measuring use of the service to improve it, without profiling: legitimate interest.

We only collect the information needed for these purposes. By creating an account, you consent to its use for these purposes, as Québec law requires; for people in the European Union, the GDPR legal bases are those listed above. No data is sold or used for advertising.

ai.title: AI generation
ai.body: To generate your content, your brief, channel preset and instructions are sent to OpenAI's API (GPT models). Under OpenAI's API terms, this data is not used to train its models; OpenAI may keep it for up to 30 days to detect abuse. If you request the video, image descriptions are also sent to OpenAI, the voice-over text to ElevenLabs for speech synthesis, and the images, voice and captions to Shotstack for editing and hosting the MP4. Do not include sensitive personal data in a brief.

processors.title: Service providers and communication outside Québec
processors.body:
- Supabase: database, authentication and media storage (images, voice-over, captions), hosted in Oregon (United States).
- OpenAI: content and image generation (United States).
- ElevenLabs: voice-over synthesis for videos (United States).
- Shotstack: video editing and hosting (Australia).
- Stripe: payment and billing.
- Vercel: application hosting, with functions running in Oregon (United States).
- Inngest: running generations in the background (United States).
- Sentry: technical error tracking (European Union).
- PostHog: usage analytics (European Union).

Your information is therefore stored and processed outside Québec, mainly in the United States, where it is subject to local laws. Each provider is bound by a written agreement that protects this information. For people in the European Union, transfers to the United States rely on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body:
- Account, workspaces and content: until the account is deleted, erased at that point.
- Accounting records: 6 years after the end of the tax year concerned, as required by tax law.
- Security fingerprints: 24 hours at most.
- Satisfaction feedback: until the account is deleted.
- Usage analytics: according to PostHog's retention period, with no possible link to your identity.
- Error reports: 30 days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
You can access your information, have it corrected or deleted, withdraw your consent and obtain a copy of it in a structured, commonly used format. If you are in the European Union, you can also object to processing or ask for it to be restricted. Your display name is changed in the settings, where the account can also be deleted, and every pipeline can be exported to Markdown, JSON or ZIP.

For any other request: {email}. We reply within 30 days. You may also file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec (cai.gouv.qc.ca) or, in the European Union, with your data protection authority (in France, the CNIL: cnil.fr).

changes.body: This policy may change, in particular when a provider is added. The update date is shown at the top of the page.

purpose.title: Why this policy
purpose.body: Pipeline AI helps produce videos. It must not be used to mislead the public, spread dangerous content or flood YouTube with videos of no value. This policy is part of the terms of use.

review.title: Before publishing
review.body:
- Check the claims flagged in the script, and any figures.
- Add your own value: angle, editing, commentary. YouTube does not monetize repetitive or mass-produced content.
- Disclose realistic altered or synthetic content in YouTube Studio, such as a synthetic voice imitating a person or generated images of real events.
- Do not use a real person's voice or likeness without their consent.
- Respect the rights to the footage, music and clips you add.

transparency.title: What Pipeline AI does not promise
transparency.body: The suggested titles and scores are decision aids, not predictions. Pipeline AI guarantees neither views, subscribers nor admission to the YouTube Partner Program.

enforcement.title: Breaches
